evidence.original_label: 出荷額 (Shipment value)
evidence.excerpt: row: 出荷額 (Shipment value); primary (disco_fy2025_yuho_jp, physical p.30) prints: '出荷額                        4,428億24百万円 (前期比       10.3％増)' (shipment value 4,428 oku + 24 hyakuman yen, +10.3% YoY); corroborating (disco_fy2025_kessan_eng, physical p.3) prints: 'Shipment value – 442.824 billion yen'. Neither source prints a single plain million-yen token -- the JP original uses the compound 億(100m)+百万(million) reading convention, the EN translation uses a decimal-billion reading -- so this packet reconciles the issuer's own two equivalent statements of the identical fact to JPY_million, the unit this packet's other DISCO monetary rows already use: [JP route] 4,428 (億, i.e. x100 in JPY_million terms) + 24 (百万円, already JPY_million) = 4,428×100 + 24 = 442,824; [EN route] 442.824 (billion) × 1,000 = 442,824. Both routes agree exactly. value: 442824 (JPY_million)

notes: DISCO's FY2025 shipment value. The page never prints this as one token: it writes 出荷額 4,428億24百万円, a compound of two differently scaled pieces with the unit words between the digits, which is how every amount on that page is written (売上高 4,368億89百万円, 営業利益 1,849億89百万円). Both pieces are declared in page_compound_scaled_parts, each is a literal token on the cited page, and the validator requires them to scale and sum to exactly the registered value: 4,428 x 100m + 24 x 1m = 442,824m. The English earnings release states the same amount as 442.824 billion yen, which reconciles independently, but it is headed an unaudited translation for reference, so the statutory Japanese filing is cited as the source. DISCO gives an exact shipment figure only from FY2025; earlier years are narrated as a record high with no numeral, confirmed across all nine filings held.
